An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] '''base''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derricon]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[T'Charek Haathi]] and [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|her team]] operated out of the base.
